blocking_reason: Exact upstream identities, clean local source snapshots, native architecture templates, and source-tree hashes are frozen, but the isolated dependency build, adapter-to-upstream integration hashes, parameter/FLOP audit, and official forward/backward memory-time smoke are not yet available.

primary_design.comparison: within-backbone paired base package versus MERIT full package
primary_design.capacity_policy: use one frozen native official configuration per family; disclose parameters/FLOPs and do not claim cross-family architectural superiority
primary_design.package_parameter_rule: within each backbone, base and MERIT arms must have identical trainable parameter count

input.channel_1: directional blur prompt map; zero for base, correct frozen oracle for MERIT
input.channel_2: noise prompt map; zero for base, correct frozen oracle for MERIT

adapter.policy: do not edit upstream source; wrap the unchanged official 3-to-3 residual model, retain output channel 0 as the restored grayscale result, and apply the original MERIT [0,1] output clamp
adapter.base_full_identity_rule: the exact same wrapper and official architecture instance definition is used in both package arms
adapter.safety_audit: forward_preclip exposes the unclipped first channel only for out-of-range and saturation accounting; forward returns the clamped training/evaluation image

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step only; recovery checkpoints cannot be selected by outcome
training.data_order: same frozen D0 parent-disjoint bank and seed-specific stream within every paired arm

nafnet.license: MIT for NAFNet code; bundled BasicSR Apache-2.0 notices retained

factory.note: The official NAFNetLocal default train_size=(1,3,256,256) is retained; the C009 448 crop is accepted by the official padded forward path.

nafnet.selection_reason: official deblurring configuration and the lower-capacity official width32 variant, frozen before C009 results

restormer.selection_reason: official motion-deblurring architecture configuration, frozen before C009 results

mambair.official_task: no official motion-deblurring recipe; x1 color-denoising architecture is used only as the native one-to-one MambaIR template

runtime_adaptations: Set the non-trainable three-channel RGB mean tensor to exact zeros before training because C009 channels are grayscale, blur prompt, and noise prompt rather than RGB.
factory.adaptation_boundary: Official source and trainable architecture remain unchanged; this task-specific input-centering constant is disclosed and applied identically to base and merit_full.

mambair.selection_reason: official ECCV 2024 MambaIR original branch and native scale-1 restoration path; task data, objective, and 448 crop are MERIT adaptations and must not be described as an official deblurring recipe

host_runtime_audit.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
host_runtime_audit.isolation_rule: do not alter the established tunnelscanning environment; build and freeze a separate G11 environment
host_runtime_audit.network_acquisition: Shell TCP 443 failed for github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com, codeload.github.com, and api.github.com on 2026-09-25; public repository metadata was independently verified, but no web content was treated as a local source snapshot

paired_training_stream_freeze.pairing_result: channel 0, target, sample order, and degradation metadata are frozen per seed; only prompt channels differ between base and merit_full
paired_training_stream_freeze.authorization_effect: This closes the paired-stream subgate only and does not authorize full training.

official_model_factory.reason: All three snapshots expose a top-level basicsr package; process isolation prevents cross-repository module contamination.

official_smoke_runner.scope: one-family-per-process paired base/full initial-state equality, trainable-parameter equality, bf16 forward/backward, finite loss/gradient, preclip range, peak VRAM, step time, and fvcore FLOPs at 448x448

acquisition.overwrite_policy: reuse an existing named target only when exact commit, clean worktree, and license all verify; otherwise refuse without overwriting
acquisition.transaction_safety: fetch missing repositories under a unique staging root, verify commit and license, create independent final worktrees by local clone rather than recursive Move-Item, and reverify all final targets
acquisition.postcondition: exact detached HEAD and retained license SHA-256 for all three repositories

adapter_unit_test.scope: dummy 3-to-3 backbone shape, first-channel selection, [0,1] clamp, preclip safety access, gradient propagation, and wrong-channel rejection only; not an official-backbone smoke

preparation_unit_tests.note: Helper tests do not substitute for official source import or GPU smoke.

closure_requirements: Retain the verified source-freeze manifest and source-preflight tree hashes without editing upstream source.
Hash the common wrapper and integration files without editing upstream source.
Build an isolated dependency environment; record all versions and any compatibility deviations from the MambaIR reference environment.
Record exact trainable parameter count, FLOPs at 448x448, and base/full equality for each official backbone.
Pass forward/backward bfloat16 smoke for base and MERIT arms without OOM and record peak memory and step time.
Recompute G13 from official-model timings before any full run.
